'Bodily injury' means bodily harm, sickness, or disease sustained by a person, including death resulting from any of these at any time.
As used in this policy, 'Your covered auto' means any vehicle shown in the Declarations and any newly acquired auto.
'Occurrence' means an accident, including continuous or repeated exposure to substantially the same general harmful conditions.
For purposes of the Cascade Term Life policy, 'Beneficiary' means the person or entity named to receive the death benefit.
What does 'actual cash value' mean? It is the cost to replace damaged property minus depreciation.
'Medically necessary' refers to services or supplies that are appropriate and consistent with the diagnosis and generally accepted medical standards.
In this travel policy, 'Family member' means your spouse, domestic partner, child, parent, sibling, grandparent, or grandchild.
'Property damage' means physical injury to tangible property, including all resulting loss of use of that property.
'Insured' means you and residents of your household who are your relatives or under the age of 21 and in your care.
A 'Dependent' is your lawful spouse and any unmarried child under age 26.
'Employee' includes a leased worker but does not include a temporary worker.
The term 'Hospital' means an institution licensed as a hospital that provides inpatient care under the supervision of physicians.
'Totally disabled' means that, due to injury or sickness, the insured is unable to perform the material duties of his or her own occupation.
As defined in your policy, 'Residence employee' means an employee of an insured whose duties relate to the maintenance or use of the residence premises.
'Pre-existing condition' means an illness or injury for which you received treatment or advice within the 60 days before your coverage effective date.
Under your Meridian Health plan, an 'In-network provider' is a doctor or facility that has contracted with us to provide services at negotiated rates.
'Collapse' means an abrupt falling down or caving in of a building or any part of a building.
'Pollutants' means any solid, liquid, gaseous, or thermal irritant or contaminant, including smoke, vapor, soot, fumes, acids, alkalis, chemicals, and waste.
The 'Policy anniversary' is the same day and month as the policy date in each later year.
What is a 'named insured'? It is the person or business listed on the declarations page as the primary policyholder.
'Trip' means a period of travel away from home to a destination outside your city of residence, with a scheduled departure and return date.
'Auto' means a land motor vehicle, trailer, or semitrailer designed for travel on public roads.
'Average weekly wage' means the employee's gross earnings during the 52 weeks preceding the injury divided by 52.
'Common carrier' means any land, sea, or air conveyance operating under a valid license for the transportation of passengers for hire.
'Insured location' means the residence premises and any premises used by you in connection with the residence premises.
'Emergency medical condition' means a condition with acute symptoms of sufficient severity that a prudent layperson could reasonably expect serious harm without immediate care.
'Your work' means work or operations performed by you or on your behalf, and materials, parts, or equipment furnished in connection with such work.
The word 'Accident' means an unforeseen, unintended event that causes bodily injury independent of all other causes.
For the purposes of this coverage part, 'Suit' means a civil proceeding in which damages to which this insurance applies are alleged.
An 'Occupational disease' is a disease arising out of employment and caused by conditions peculiar to the employee's work.
'Face amount' is the amount of insurance shown on the policy specifications page.
'Covered person' means the insured, the insured's spouse, and eligible dependent children enrolled under this plan.
'Business' includes any trade, profession, or occupation engaged in on a full-time, part-time, or occasional basis.
'Replacement cost' means the cost to repair or replace damaged property with materials of like kind and quality, without deduction for depreciation.
In your auto policy, 'Family member' means a person related to you by blood, marriage, or adoption who is a resident of your household.
'Allowed amount' is the maximum amount the plan will consider for payment of a covered service.
'Impaired property' means tangible property, other than your product or your work, that cannot be used or is less useful because of a defect in your product or your work.
'Terminal illness' means a medical condition that is expected to result in death within 12 months, as certified by a physician.
'Uninsured motor vehicle' means a land motor vehicle or trailer for which no bodily injury liability bond or policy applies at the time of the accident.
